source: If expert widths are held fixed, moving from Top-1 to Top-2 approximately doubles the expert-ZXNAME0000XZ computation for that ZXNAME0001XZ layer. It does not necessarily double whole-model FLOPs because attention, embeddings, normalization, shared experts, and other layers remain.
zh: 如果专家宽度保持固定，则从 Top-1 移动到 Top-2 大约会使该 ZXNAME0001XZ 层的 Expert-ZXNAME0000XZ 计算增加一倍。它不一定会使整个模型的 FLOP 翻倍，因为注意力、嵌入、标准化、共享专家和其他层仍然存在。
